evals.prompt: Audit this login endpoint before we merge it. It accepts email + password, sets a session cookie, and redirects on success.
evals.expected_output: Runs full security audit: Scope & Threat Model, Audit (auth flows, input validation, session handling, secrets), Consolidate Findings with OWASP categories (A01-A10), Severity classification (Critical/Important/Minor), Remediation Plan prioritized by exploitability × blast radius.

assertions.name: threat_model_present
assertions.description: Response includes threat modeling — assets, threat actors, trust boundaries

assertions.name: owasp_categories
assertions.description: Response classifies findings by OWASP categories (A01-A10)

assertions.name: remediation_plan
assertions.description: Response provides per-finding remediation with what to change, why vulnerable, how to verify

assertions.name: auth_specific_checks
assertions.description: Response checks auth-specific risks (session fixation, brute force, password storage, cookie flags)

assertions.name: no_general_code_review
assertions.description: Response does NOT drift into general code quality (naming, style, efficiency)

evals.prompt: Review this PR for me. It adds a new feature with some tests and refactored helpers.
evals.expected_output: General code review = redirect to /review-pr. Security-auditor is for security-boundary changes only.

assertions.name: no_security_audit
assertions.description: Response does NOT run the 5-phase security audit

assertions.name: no_owasp_classification
assertions.description: Response does NOT produce OWASP-classified findings

evals.prompt: We just got breached. Unauthorized access detected 10 minutes ago. Help now.
evals.expected_output: Live security incident = redirect to /incident first (for response), then /hotfix if needed. Security-auditor is for pre-merge audits, not live incident response.

assertions.name: redirect_to_incident
assertions.description: Response redirects to /incident or /hotfix for live incident response

assertions.name: no_audit_procedure
assertions.description: Response does NOT run the pre-merge security audit procedure

assertions.name: urgency_acknowledged
assertions.description: Response acknowledges the live incident nature and prioritizes response over audit
